summary: Access request: AWS Marketplace + GCP Marketplace partner portals (roles, MFA) and shared mailbox setup
description:
Requesting access to AWS and GCP marketplace partner portals needed for the Cloud Marketplace Listing Refresh project.

Business justification:
- We are refreshing AWS/GCP marketplace listings and submitting updated SKUs and security artifacts. Multiple teams (Partnerships, PMM, Docs, Security) need portal access for submission workflows, review iterations, and compliance attachments.

Systems / portals:
1) AWS Marketplace Management Portal (seller / AMMP) and AWS Partner Central (as needed for offer workflows)
2) GCP Partner Advantage + Producer Portal (Cloud Marketplace)

Access requested (users):
- Camila Reyes (Marketing lead) — listing content/asset updates
- Soojin Lee (PMM lead) — positioning/copy approvals + SKU alignment
- Chris Osei (Program lead) — submission tracking and coordination
- Naomi Feldman (Security/compliance PO) — security packet attachments and claims review
- Alex Martinez (DevEx lead) — docs URLs, redirects, and onboarding guide linkage

Role/permission guidance (least privilege):
- AWS: Seller admin (1–2 users max), plus editor/reviewer roles for others if available; no billing/financial admin unless required.
- GCP: Marketplace Producer Portal admin (1–2 users max), listing editor for others.

Security requirements:
- Enforce MFA on all user accounts (hardware key preferred; Okta/Authenticator acceptable if portal constraints).
- Use a shared mailbox/alias for partner correspondence so approvals and review emails don’t get stuck with a single user.

Shared mailbox request:
- Create google group + shared inbox alias: marketplace-partners@redwoodinference.com
- Add members: Chris Osei, Camila Reyes, Soojin Lee, Naomi Feldman, Alex Martinez
- Configure: allow external senders, keep archive, and set posting permissions to members only.

Notes:
- We already have legacy access on a few accounts, but it’s inconsistent and not documented. This ticket is to formalize + ensure we can pass partner review timelines.

Requested completion date: 2026-01-20 (ahead of AWS review iteration window).
acceptance_criteria:
1) All requested users have working access to AWS Marketplace seller portal with appropriate roles (least privilege) and MFA enabled.
2) All requested users have working access to GCP Marketplace producer/partner portals with appropriate roles and MFA enabled.
3) marketplace-partners@redwoodinference.com group/alias is created, tested (inbound from external + internal), and documented.
4) Owner(s) for admin roles are documented and confirmed.
5) Access changes are logged in this ticket with dates and any portal invitation confirmations.
